systems.country_label: Integrated National Digital Mortality Surveillance, Registration and Certification System
systems.tiers: Not yet built: prospective suppliers engaged and a prototype dashboard shown (reported 7 August 2026); planned with web, mobile and offline use, and expected to integrate with the Medical Certification of Cause of Death work of the Ministry of Health, NCRA and WHO
Launched January 2026; integrates health data streams

systems.system: electronic Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (eIDSR)

note: The system is the public health agency's, planned and not the civil registrar's, so no fact is recorded; the document also states that only about 13.4 per cent of deaths are fully registered, a share of events and not of offices.
